scope: AC1018 TABLE-level 18-bit border-color CMC DWG output

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: An optional border-color Boolean precedes an 18-bit mask. One CMC value follows for each selected mask bit, in ascending bit order, before the lineweight and visibility mask groups.

implementation.codec: DRW_Table::encodeDwgWithExtension now writes the optional border-color flag, mask, and selected CMC entries in 18-slot order. It accepts C0/ByLayer, C1/ByBlock and C3/indexed ACI only. The parser marks other methods, color/book strings, unknown CMC flags and invalid indices semantically incomplete. Unselected nondefault color slots refuse.
implementation.readback_model: The shared bounded TABLE CMC reader stores the normalized payload index, preserving the ACI value independently from the reserved leading BS.
implementation.compatibility: No public virtuals, public object layout or drawing fixture files were changed. DXF per-row border CMC output remains refused when distinct title/header/data values cannot be represented by one entity-level group value.

checks: Sparse selected border colors encode and read back with the exact mask and normalized CMC methods/indices
Wire walk verifies ascending selected-slot order and the subsequent empty lineweight/visibility flags
The table override range ends at the exact body cursor and the following sentinel remains readable
Selected truecolor and unselected nondefault values refuse without publishing output
generated_control.fixture_policy: Generated in memory from test code; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests -j4 passed with repository warning-as-error settings

limits: The generated wire vector proves codec/parser consistency, not physical producer ordering or profile prevalence.
Native TABLE border rendering and precedence remain unqualified.
The separately refused DXF per-row border CMC profile remains constrained by entity-level group-code representability; parsed TABLE source-range replay remains open.
